messages.content:
Risk: Personal Info
Description: When personal identifiable information (PII) or sensitive personal information (SPI) are used in training data, fine-tuning data, seed data for synthetic data generation, or as part of the prompt, models might reveal that data in the generated output. Revealing personal information is a type of data leakage.
Concern: Sharing people's PI impacts their rights and make them more vulnerable.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0024: Exfiltration via AI Inference API - ATLAS — Adversaries may exfiltrate private information via [AI Model Inference API Access](/techniques/AML.T0040).
AI Models have been shown leak private information about their training data (e.g.  [Infer Training Data Membership](/techniques/AML.T0024.000), [Invert AI Model](/techniques/AML.T0024.001)).
The model itself may also be extracted ([Extract AI Model](/techniques/AML.T0024.002)) for the purposes of [AI Intellectual Property Theft](/techniques/AML.T0048.004).

Exfiltration of information relating to private training data raises privacy concerns.
Private training data may include personally identifiable information, or other protected data. [found by 4/11 queries]
  Siblings: LLM Response Rendering - ATLAS, Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation - ATLAS, LLM Data Leakage - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 3/11 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure — Disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as names, addresses, government identifiers, or biometric data. [found by 3/11 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0024.001: Invert AI Model - ATLAS — AI models' training data could be reconstructed by exploiting the confidence scores that are available via an inference API.
By querying the inference API strategically, adversaries can back out potentially private information embedded within the training data.
This could lead to privacy violations if the attacker can reconstruct the data of sensitive features used in the algorithm. [found by 3/11 queries]
  Siblings: Extract AI Model - ATLAS, Infer Training Data Membership - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-202: Exposure of Sensitive Information Through Data Queries — When trying to keep information confidential, an attacker can often infer some of the information by using statistics. [found by 3/11 queries]
  Siblings: Improper Authorization of Index Containing Sensitive Information

axes.cco_class_label: Exfiltration via AI Inference API - ATLAS
axes.rationale: This class captures the risk of personal information being leaked through the model's output, aligning with the description of data leakage as a concern.
This class specifically addresses the disclosure of directly identifiable information, which is a core aspect of the 'Personal Info' risk.
